text_blocks.snippet: Morgan Stanley Mortgage Capital Holdings LLC is a subsidiary of Morgan Stanley, involved in the mortgage business. It focuses on originating, selling, and servicing mortgage loans. The company is structured as a limited liability company and is based in New York.
Key aspects of Morgan Stanley Mortgage Capital Holdings LLC:

list.title: Part of Morgan Stanley:
list.snippet: It is a component of the larger Morgan Stanley financial services organization.

list.title: Mortgage Loan Activities:
list.snippet: The company handles the process of originating mortgage loans, selling them to investors, and managing the ongoing servicing of those loans.

list.title: Structure:
list.snippet: It is a limited liability company (LLC), a common business structure that provides certain legal protections to its owners.

list.title: Location:
list.snippet: Its primary operational base is in New York City, specifically at 1585 Broadway.

list.title: Part of a Larger Restructuring:
list.snippet: In the past, Morgan Stanley reorganized its mortgage business, which included consolidating operations under a single platform.

list.title: Part of a Settlement:
list.snippet: The SEC ordered Morgan Stanley and its subsidiaries, including Morgan Stanley Mortgage Capital Holdings LLC, to pay a substantial amount for misleading public disclosures related to mortgage-backed securities.
